subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link preview support allow `updateConfiguration` plus explicit preview-field pass-through, and what default plus per-account semantics should `channels.signal.linkPreview` use?
rationale: The implementation surface is clear, but default behavior, linked-device failure handling, multi-account semantics, and the untrusted metadata boundary are security/product choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in support
options.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the link-preview metadata boundary, then implement the Signal config.

options.title: Default-on support
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default while preserving an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in support
recommendation.body: Add a default-safe Signal plugin setting that only passes caller-provided preview fields and documents primary-device limits before enabling `updateConfiguration`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Signal send/config/docs history and already supplied relevant maintainer-facing context on this issue.
